Kong/insomnia
The open-source, cross-platform API client for GraphQL, REST, WebSockets, SSE and gRPC. With Cloud, Local and Git storage.
TypeScript repository by Kong, created in 2016, with 40,139 stars and 2,393 forks. License: Apache-2.0. Starred on 2019-07-09.
